sources.title: Psychological Safety and Learning Behavior in Work Teams
sources.author: Amy Edmondson (1999)
sources.type: primary empirical paper, author-repository abstract inspected
sources.supported_use: Interpersonal risk and learning behavior in work teams.
sources.limits: Abstract-only use; association in 51 manufacturing teams, not a universal causal claim, productivity comparison or assurance that dissent is safe.

sources.title: How to implement CRediT
sources.author: NISO CRediT
sources.sections: Researcher guidance and contributor review/confirmation recommendations
sources.supported_use: Clarify contributions, allow shared roles and confirm accurate credit.
sources.limits: Research-output setting; no personality assessment, universal team model or task validation.

sources.title: Our Epidemic of Loneliness and Isolation: The U.S. Surgeon General’s Advisory
sources.author: US Department of Health and Human Services (2023)
sources.sections: PDF pages 6, 9 and 17: solitude, structure/function/quality and community conditions
sources.supported_use: Differentiate forms and functions of connection and recognize structural barriers.
sources.limits: Selected sections only; no causal claim for this activity, social quota, health effect estimate or loneliness cure.

sources.title: Pursuing Meaningful Work: A Guide for PhDs and Postdocs
sources.author: Stanford Career Education (2018–2019)
sources.sections: PDF page 11 / printed page 10, Build Your Network
sources.supported_use: Professional connection includes reciprocal support, ideas and information.
sources.limits: Only the stated network section is used. Original separate-consent design here is not a tested result from this guide; no career outcome promise.

sources.title: The Science of Effective Mentorship in STEMM — interactive guide
sources.author: National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine (2019)
sources.sections: Defining mentorship and setting expectations; working alliance over time
sources.supported_use: Use explicit expectations and attend to growth and contributions across a mentoring relationship.
sources.limits: STEMM educational context; not evidence that age establishes expertise or that one exchange creates lasting friendship.

sources.title: UNESCO Universal Declaration on Cultural Diversity
sources.author: UNESCO (2001)
sources.supported_use: Cultural belonging and participation remain bounded by human dignity and rights.
sources.limits: Normative declaration, not local legal advice, a complete account of communal duties or empirical exercise validation.

sources.title: Receptiveness to Opposing Views: Conceptualization and Integrative Review
sources.author: Julia A. Minson and Frances S. Chen (online 2021; issue 2022)
sources.type: primary theoretical/integrative paper, publisher abstract inspected
sources.supported_use: Receptiveness includes considering opposing views and can be shaped by interaction.
sources.limits: Abstract-only use; no persuasion guarantee, obligation to debate dignity, or methods-level validation of this exercise.

sources.title: Green flags in relationships
sources.author: love is respect / National Domestic Violence Hotline
sources.sections: Communication, respect, trust, honesty, equality and boundaries sections
sources.supported_use: Attend to respectful conduct and boundaries while considering a relationship.
sources.limits: Not a diagnostic checklist, compatibility score or universal philosophy of love. Source serves youth; these companions restrict live practice to suitable voluntary adults.

sources.title: What consent does—and doesn’t—look like
sources.author: love is respect / National Domestic Violence Hotline
sources.sections: Consent, assumptions, pressure and continuing choice sections
sources.supported_use: Consent is freely given and specific; previous willingness or gifts do not authorize another step.
sources.limits: Not jurisdiction-specific legal guidance; invitation examples are author design. Visible enthusiasm is not an accessibility requirement; no safety guarantee.

sources.title: Machine learning uncovers the most robust self-report predictors of relationship quality across 43 longitudinal couples studies
sources.author: Samantha Joel and colleagues (2020)
sources.supported_use: Consider relationship experience and the limits of predicting relationship-quality change.
sources.limits: Abstract-only use; existing-couple self-report datasets do not validate partner selection, the eight scope headings or an individual future forecast.

sources.title: Are adult attachment styles categorical or dimensional? A taxometric analysis of general and relationship-specific attachment orientations
sources.author: R. Chris Fraley, Nathan W. Hudson, Marie E. Heffernan and Noam Segal (2015)
sources.supported_use: Evidence in two samples favors dimensional rather than categorical descriptions.
sources.limits: Abstract-only use; no individual diagnosis, clinical treatment claim or validation of the six behavioral teaching distinctions.

sources.title: Intimacy as an Interpersonal Process: The Importance of Self-Disclosure, Partner Disclosure, and Perceived Partner Responsiveness in Interpersonal Exchanges
sources.author: Jean-Philippe Laurenceau, Lisa Feldman Barrett and Paula R. Pietromonaco (1998)
sources.type: primary empirical paper, selected opening sections inspected
sources.sections: PDF pages 1–2: abstract and opening interpersonal-process discussion
sources.supported_use: Disclosure and perceived responsiveness can both matter to experienced intimacy.
sources.limits: Opening sections only, not an independent full methods audit. Diary associations do not prescribe more disclosure, forced reciprocity or a universally safe intimacy exercise.

sources.title: Plan for Safety
sources.author: National Domestic Violence Hotline
sources.sections: Personalized planning and responsibility for abusive behavior
sources.supported_use: Abuse concerns warrant individualized support rather than compulsory mutual communication.
sources.limits: US service context; verify suitable local resources and safe contact. No personalized plan or guaranteed safety; browser-history clearing is not presented as protection.
